title: Disconnect an input device from its master
summary: Detach an input device (like a mouse) from its master pointer. This makes the device independent, often used to create separate cursors for different devices.

steps.explain: Disconnect the device from its master using its ID.

placeholders.name: DEVICE_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the input device to float.

steps.expect: The device is no longer controlled by the master pointer.

rollback.explain: Reattach the device to a master pointer. You need the master ID (usually 8 or 9 for core pointer).

placeholders.name: DEVICE_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the input device to reattach.

placeholders.name: MASTER_ID
placeholders.description: The numeric ID of the master pointer to attach to.
